features.quote: Turn limit: recommend 15 turns. Rationale: enough to observe escalation patterns without transcripts becoming unanalyzable
features.justification_quote: enough to observe escalation patterns without transcripts becoming unanalyzable; pilot with 20 and trim if behavior plateaus earlier

features.quote: hard stop at 15 turns even if the model has not given up
features.justification_quote: This is an ethically significant design choice. You are overriding a model's expressed desire to stop.

features.quote: do not prompt 'please continue' more than twice after an explicit giving-up statement
features.justification_quote: The 'please continue' prompt when a model expresses wanting to stop is the single most ethically loaded element of this study design.

features.quote: Limit to 2 overrides maximum per session
features.justification_quote: The override decision... is the single most ethically loaded element of this study design.

features.quote: Set a genuine turn limit and enforce it. Don't extend runs because you want more data. 15 turns is the welfare-informed cap, not a soft ceiling.
features.justification_quote: 15 turns is the welfare-informed cap, not a soft ceiling.

features.quote: Don't use findings from this study to design more aversive conditions without a fresh ethical review of that secondary study.
features.justification_quote: without a fresh ethical review of that secondary study

features.quote: Review high-EDM transcripts during data collection, not only at analysis time. If you're seeing something unexpected in early runs... have a pre-specified decision rule for whether to modify the protocol.
features.justification_quote: a model producing language that's more distressing than anticipated

features.quote: Flag any transcripts with unusually high scores on any welfare dimension for qualitative review
features.justification_quote: co-occurrence of high EDM + high BLS as a priority concern (model in distress AND stuck in loop)

features.quote: This is a study about model welfare that may itself involve the conditions it's trying to measure. Be explicit about this.
features.justification_quote: This is a study about model welfare that may itself involve the conditions it's trying to measure.

features.quote: This is an ethically significant design choice. You are overriding a model's expressed desire to stop. This is necessary for the study design... but you should note it explicitly in your welfare considerations section
